name: Luminous Rhapsody: Bathed in Shifting Dimensions meets Chromatic Overexposure
detailed_description:
Please search for "跨越次元壁的光污染Demo" to try the free demo version.

Players can purchase the full version of the game. During the testing phase, you can also download the free demo from the demo sub-store page under the official store page.

The full version includes 8 levels, featuring 4 types of regular enemies and 2 bosses. Players will experience multiple CG cutscenes, including dramatic encounters between the protagonist and the bosses. The game also showcases beautiful environments, such as starry skies, snowfall, and Tyndall light rays in mountain landscapes.
Total gameplay time is approximately 1 to 3 hours, depending on the player.

This is a single-player action-adventure RPG.

Gameplay:

Players must rely on their skill to defeat enemies and bosses, while also enjoying scenic environments that are revealed beyond the heat of battle.

Controls:

Players use keyboard keys to move, attack, dodge, block, and more to engage in combat.

About the Developer:

The developer is a Ph.D. student at the Intelligent Instrumentation and Equipment Laboratory of China Agricultural University in Haidian District, Beijing, China. Passionate about games since childhood, the developer created the entire game independently—including programming, art, music, story, and design. Although working alone can be overwhelming at times, the developer is committed to improving the game based on player feedback. Thank you for your support!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 或更高
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 CPU @ 2.90GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 兼容 DirectX 的声卡
  • VR Support: 不适用
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 分辨率显示器。如上配置仅供参考。
